title: Observable vocabulary
description: The observable terms a scenario may use. Each term has a meaning, a frame, units, and a rule for when a per-robot nominal applies. It does not map a term to an MCAP channel or to a robot model; that is the observation-binding format and the robot bindings. See docs/observable-vocabulary.md.

scope.description: The scenario family the terms cover, for example hallway. A term is added only when a scenario fixture uses it.

id.description: The observable as a scenario step and a binding name it, for example base_height.

name.description: The term as scenario text reads it, for example base height.

frame.description: What the value is measured in or against.

units.description: Units in words, from a closed set: meters and seconds. A term that needs another unit adds it here first.

applies.description: never: the term has no per-robot nominal. per-robot-configuration: a nominal value exists for each robot and configuration.

metrics.description: Evaluator metrics defined in terms of this term. Optional.

id.description: The evaluator's metric name, for example wall_contacts.

maps.description: How the metric relates to the term.

sources.description: Where the hallway evaluator and its fixtures use the term, so the definition can be checked against them.
